info.title: Odexa Order API
info.description: Single-product checkout, owned customer queries and explicit tenant merchant views. Bearer JWTs validate issuer and odexa-api audience. CUSTOMER operations always scope tenant_id and sub; merchant operations require MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER and scope tenant_id. Tenant/owner filters cannot be supplied by clients. No support/platform bypass. Responses contain no customer subject or provider references.

post.summary: Create or replay a single-product checkout
post.description: Requires CUSTOMER. Idempotency is scoped to (JWT tenant_id, JWT sub, Idempotency-Key). The semantic request identity is productId, quantity, and paymentMethod; JSON property order and UUID letter case do not change it. The first successful insertion returns 201; an exact retry returns 200, the same order ID and Location, and its current state. Reusing the scoped key for different intent returns 409. Concurrent requests are resolved by a database unique constraint. Persisted retries never call catalog. For a new key, catalog is authoritative for price, currency, product name and version; the original bearer JWT and correlation ID are forwarded using bounded timeouts. A catalog failure without a concurrently committed matching order returns 503 and persists no order. Checkout requires a strictly positive catalog unit price and total. Zero-amount checkout is not supported: a free product returns 422 (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE) before any new order or order.created event is persisted, so no stock is reserved. Checkout does not synchronously charge a payment method. Order creation and order.created publication via transactional outbox are atomic. Keys remain reserved while the order record is retained; no expiration is implemented.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Case-sensitive opaque key containing 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters (U+0021 through U+007E; no spaces or controls). Reuse this key when retrying the same checkout, including after an ambiguous network failure.

404.description: Product does not exist or is not accessible to this tenant (PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The scoped key already represents different intent (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT), or a new checkout targets an inactive product (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE).

422.description: Product has a zero unit price (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE): Zero-amount checkout is not supported. No new order or order.created event is persisted and no stock is reserved.

503.description: Catalog timeout, transport failure, invalid authoritative snapshot, or upstream failure (CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE). No new order is persisted. Retrying an already persisted order does not require catalog availability.

get.description: Requires CUSTOMER; scopes tenant and authenticated subject. Deterministic descending (createdAt, id) keyset order; default 20, maximum 100. Newly created later orders do not shift continuation pages. Status is a live filter; results are not a multi-request snapshot. Date range is inclusive lower/exclusive upper. Unknown or repeated parameters are rejected, including tenantId/customerId. Invalid input returns 400 with INVALID_ORDER_LIMIT, INVALID_ORDER_CURSOR, INVALID_ORDER_STATUS, INVALID_ORDER_TIMESTAMP, INVALID_ORDER_DATE_RANGE or INVALID_ORDER_FILTER.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque versioned token returned as nextCursor. Keep filters unchanged when following it.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Exclusive creation timestamp. Must be later than createdFrom.

get.description: Requires CUSTOMER. Looks up by order UUID AND JWT tenant_id AND JWT sub. Unknown IDs, cross-tenant IDs and another customer's IDs all return the same 404. Poll this resource for asynchronous state changes. Payment outcomes delivered before their inventory.reserved causation event are durably deferred: the visible status remains CREATED until that event is validated. Terminal states never move backwards or change in response to late contradictory outcomes.

200.description: Current order snapshot. Payment method, customer identity, and internal causal evidence are not exposed.

404.description: Order is absent or not owned by the authenticated customer in this tenant (ORDER_NOT_FOUND).

get.summary: List orders within the merchant’s tenant
get.description: Requires MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER; includes all customers within this tenant. No identity/profile information is returned. Deterministic descending (createdAt, id) keyset order; default 20, maximum 100. Newly created later orders do not shift continuation pages. Status is a live filter; results are not a multi-request snapshot. Date range is inclusive lower/exclusive upper. Unknown or repeated parameters are rejected, including tenantId/customerId. Invalid input returns 400 with INVALID_ORDER_LIMIT, INVALID_ORDER_CURSOR, INVALID_ORDER_STATUS, INVALID_ORDER_TIMESTAMP, INVALID_ORDER_DATE_RANGE or INVALID_ORDER_FILTER.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque versioned token returned as nextCursor. Keep filters unchanged when following it.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Exclusive creation timestamp. Must be later than createdFrom.

200.description: List orders within the merchant’s tenant

post.summary: Cancel an owned checkout before dispatch begins
post.description: Requires CUSTOMER and tenant/owner match. No body or query parameters. Synchronously commits CANCELLED only when CREATED, without deferred payment evidence, and the durable publication fence proves checkout has never been attempted. Dispatch races are serialized by database locks. Already CANCELLED returns 200 with the same resource, including after restart. All other states or attempted/uncertain publication return 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE; no stock is released and no payment reversed. No If-Match or separate Idempotency-Key is required: the command has no mutable payload and checks eligibility atomically. The cancellation fact references the withdrawn checkout event; the checkout event is never delivered.

200.description: Cancel an owned checkout before dispatch begins

404.description: ORDER_NOT_FOUND: absent or outside the permitted tenant/owner scope.

409.description: ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: checkout may already have escaped or the order has another terminal/in-flight state.

bearerAuth.description: OIDC issuer-validated JWT, audience odexa-api, UUID tenant_id, nonempty sub, and the realm_access.roles entry each operation requires: CUSTOMER for customer operations, MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER for merchant operations.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: UUID correlation identifier; a new UUID is generated if absent. Propagated to catalog and events. Invalid non-UUID values are rejected.

OrderLocation.description: Relative URI of the same order on creation and every exact retry.

paymentMethod.description: Opaque sandbox provider reference. pm_approved authorizes; pm_declined declines. Raw payment card data is not accepted.

totalMinor.description: Strictly positive immutable catalog unit price in minor units multiplied by quantity, with overflow checked. Zero-amount checkout is not supported.

status.description: CREATED awaits inventory and may already have payment in flight. PENDING_PAYMENT has reservation evidence. All other states are terminal. CANCELLED and EXPIRED apply only to never-dispatched checkout; uncertain payments never expire. Early payment evidence and its reservation may apply two transitions atomically, both recorded in history.

version.description: Starts at zero; increases once per domain state transition. Applying a deferred payment after its reservation increases by two. Duplicate or ignored late events do not increment it. Internal deferred evidence alone does not change the public version.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in UTC, normalized to database precision.

Problem.description: Sanitized RFC 9457 problem detail. Business problem types are https://odexa.cc/problems/{lowercase-code}. Additional transport metadata may be present.

nextCursor.description: Opaque next-page token, or null when no additional row matched at query time.

occurredAt.description: UTC local transition recording time; nondecreasing by version. LEGACY_SNAPSHOT time is migration observation time, not an inferred historic transition.

OrderHistory.description: Ascending version; bounded by the acyclic lifecycle. No Kafka metadata. Complete for new orders; old orders begin with a LEGACY_SNAPSHOT.

CreatedOrder.description: New order durably created with its outbox event.

ReplayedOrder.description: Existing matching order; same ID and Location, current state; no new order or order.created event.

BadRequest.description: Malformed input or a stable query validation code: INVALID_ORDER_LIMIT, INVALID_ORDER_CURSOR, INVALID_ORDER_STATUS, INVALID_ORDER_TIMESTAMP, INVALID_ORDER_DATE_RANGE, INVALID_ORDER_FILTER. Unknown/repeated query parameters are rejected on collections; cancellation accepts no parameters/body.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, including issuer/audience validation failures.

Forbidden.description: Required operation role or valid tenant/subject claims are missing. Merchant views require MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER; customer operations require CUSTOMER. No implicit support/platform access.
